The main takeaway from our work is that
a linear isomer of an angular core can have a better antiproliferation activity than the angular isomer.
the linear isomer of the annelated thiochromenopyrimidines can be obtained by an unusual Dimroth reaction.
the unexpected linear isomer can be obtained in good yield from the reaction leading to the angular isomer, and it can be used to design new compounds with potent antitumoral activity.
